info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Nosean Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Nosean Battery Detail Management API enables users to efficiently manage detailed information related to Nosean batteries within the catalog. This endpoint allows authorized personnel to add new battery details, ensuring that the catalog is up-to-date with the latest specifications and features. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and product developers who need to maintain accurate records of battery product data. Leverage this API to streamline your inventory management and enhance product information accuracy.

post.summary: Create details for a Nosean battery.
post.description: This endpoint is used to create or register the details associated with a Nosean battery. It allows users to provide necessary information and parameters that pertain to the specific battery being registered, ensuring that all data is accurately captured for future reference and operation.

requestBody.description: The payload required to create or update details for a Nosean battery. It should contain all necessary information about the battery specifications and attributes as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning battery details.

nosean_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the Nosean battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of Nosean batteries being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Nosean battery.

supplier.description: The supplier information for the Nosean battery request.

CreateCatalogNoseanBatteryDetailRequest.description: Request body for creating or processing a Nosean battery operation.

name.description: The name of the supplier providing the Nosean batteries.

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier is verified.

Supplier.description: Schema representing information about a supplier.

email.description: The email address for contacting the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number for contacting the supplier.

SupplierContact.description: Schema representing the contact information for a supplier.

CreateCatalogNoseanBatteryDetailResponse.title: Battery Operations Response

status.description: The status of the operation, represented as a string.

recordId.description: The unique identifier associated with the record created or modified during the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed, typically in ISO 8601 format.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

CreateCatalogNoseanBatteryDetailResponse.description: Schema representing the response returned after a successful POST operation for battery details.
